metadata.provenance: OPHI Global MPI Country Briefing 2023 for India, based on DHS/NFHS 2019-21.
metadata.method: Global MPI identifies people deprived in at least one third of weighted indicators across health, education and living standards. Intensity is the average deprivation score among the MPI poor.
metadata.caveat: This is the global MPI, not NITI's national MPI. It uses a different indicator set and should not be treated as directly interchangeable with India's national MPI.
